summary.text: Paul Thomas is a Republican member of the North Dakota Senate representing District 6 (Velva), serving since 2025 (he served in the House from 2021 to 2024). His standing committees in the 2025 regular session are Appropriations.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Thomas is a farmer with a BS in agricultural economics from NDSU.
His biography lists past service on the Velva City Commission, and affiliations with the Velva Sales Tax Committee, the ND Corn Growers Association, the ND Farm Bureau and the Knights of Columbus.
In the interim he is vice chair of the Education Committee and serves on the Budget Section.
His biography lists him as married to Karen, with two children.
